title: Artisan Sourdough Bread Baking
summary: Build and keep a starter, then bake open-crumb country loaves, baguettes and a seeded rye at home.
learn: Feed and maintain a wild-yeast starter; Mix, stretch-and-fold and shape by hand; Read proof by feel and by the poke test; Score and bake in a home oven with a Dutch oven
bring: A 1-litre jar for your starter and a container for your loaves

title: French Pastry & Viennoiserie
summary: Laminated dough from scratch: croissants, pain au chocolat, kouign-amann and Danish pastries.
learn: Make and lock in a butter block; Laminate with three single folds; Proof and bake croissants with an open honeycomb; Shape pain au chocolat, kouign-amann and Danish

title: Wedding Cake Design & Decoration
summary: Stacked, dowelled and decorated tiered cakes, including fondant covering and sugar flowers.
learn: Level, fill and crumb-coat stable layers; Dowel and stack a three-tier cake safely; Cover with fondant with sharp edges; Model gumpaste roses and piped lace
allergens: wheat (gluten), dairy, eggs, may contain nuts
bring: A cake carrier for your final tier. Prerequisite: BAK-106 or equivalent experience

title: Macaron Masterclass
summary: French and Italian meringue macarons with ganache and buttercream fillings.
learn: Age egg whites and sift almond flour correctly; Macaronage to the right lava-like flow; Pipe even shells and control feet; Fill, mature and store macarons
allergens: TREE NUTS (almond), eggs, dairy — not suitable for nut allergies

title: Chocolate & Confectionery Making
summary: Tempering, moulded bonbons, pralines, caramels and hand-rolled truffles.
learn: Temper dark, milk and white chocolate by seeding; Cast shells and fill moulded bonbons; Cook caramel and nougat to temperature; Hand-roll and enrobe truffles

title: Cupcake & Cake Pops Workshop
summary: A one-session workshop: bake, frost and decorate cupcakes and cake pops.
learn: Bake a light vanilla and chocolate sponge; Pipe buttercream swirls and rosettes; Roll, dip and decorate cake pops
bring: Nothing — boxes are provided. Suitable for ages 12+ with a guardian

title: Bread Making Fundamentals
summary: Yeasted breads for the home baker: sandwich loaf, focaccia, soft milk buns and pizza dough.
learn: Measure by weight and understand hydration; Knead by hand and check the windowpane; Shape a tin loaf, rolls and focaccia; Bake with steam in a home oven

title: Cookie & Biscuit Baking
summary: A one-session workshop: chewy, crisp and iced cookies, shortbread and biscotti.
learn: Control spread with butter temperature; Make shortbread and twice-baked biscotti; Flood and pipe royal icing
allergens: wheat (gluten), dairy, eggs, may contain nuts
bring: Nothing — boxes are provided. Suitable for ages 12+ with a guardian

title: Pie & Tart Specialist
summary: Flaky and sweet shortcrust, blind baking, custards, lemon tart and a lattice fruit pie.
learn: Make flaky and pâte sucrée pastry; Line and blind-bake without shrinkage; Cook crème pâtissière and lemon curd; Weave a lattice top
allergens: wheat (gluten), dairy, eggs, may contain nuts

title: Korean & Asian Bakery
summary: Tangzhong milk bread, salt bread, cream cheese garlic bread and Hong Kong egg tarts.
learn: Make tangzhong and water-roux doughs; Shape salt bread and filled buns; Bake Hong Kong-style egg tarts; Make a cream cheese garlic filling

title: Italian Cuisine Mastery
summary: Fresh pasta, risotto, braises and regional Italian classics cooked from scratch.
learn: Roll fresh egg pasta and filled shapes; Cook risotto to all'onda; Braise osso buco and make ragù; Plate a four-course Italian menu

title: Thai Street Food Cooking
summary: Pad thai, green curry from a fresh paste, som tam and mango sticky rice.
learn: Pound a green curry paste by hand; Balance sweet, sour, salty and hot; Wok-fry pad thai for two; Steam sticky rice

title: Japanese Sushi & Sashimi
summary: Sushi rice, knife work for sashimi, maki, nigiri and temaki with safe raw-fish handling.
learn: Season and cool sushi rice; Break down and slice fish for sashimi; Roll hosomaki and uramaki; Form nigiri and handle raw fish safely
allergens: fish, shellfish, soy, sesame, wheat (soy sauce)

title: French Culinary Foundations
summary: The classical base: knife cuts, stocks, the mother sauces, roasting, poaching and plating.
learn: Classic cuts: julienne, brunoise, chiffonade; Make brown and white stocks; Cook the five mother sauces; Roast, poach and plate a French menu
bring: Closed-toe shoes; knives and aprons are provided

title: Chinese Wok Cooking
summary: Wok hei, velveting, stir-fries, fried rice and Cantonese sauces.
learn: Season and control a carbon-steel wok; Velvet chicken and beef; Cook egg fried rice with wok hei; Make oyster, black bean and sweet-sour sauces

title: Indian Curry & Spices
summary: Whole and ground spices, tempering, North and South Indian curries, dal and flatbreads.
learn: Toast, grind and temper spices; Build a masala base; Cook a North and a South Indian curry; Make dal and chapati

title: Healthy Meal Prep & Nutrition
summary: Plan, batch-cook and store a balanced week of lunches and dinners.
learn: Plan a balanced weekly menu; Batch-cook grains, proteins and vegetables; Store and reheat food safely; Read nutrition labels
allergens: varies by menu; vegetarian options available

title: Vegetarian & Vegan Cuisine
summary: Satisfying plant-based mains, tofu and tempeh, grain bowls and dairy-free desserts. Fully vegan menu.
learn: Press, marinate and crisp tofu and tempeh; Build umami without meat; Make plant-based sauces and dressings; Cook a dairy-free dessert
allergens: soy, may contain nuts and sesame; no meat, dairy or eggs

title: Grilling & BBQ Mastery
summary: Charcoal control, direct and indirect heat, marinades, rubs and satay.
learn: Set up two-zone charcoal heat; Grill to temperature with a probe; Make rubs, marinades and satay sauce; Rest and carve meat

title: Knife Skills & Kitchen Essentials
summary: A one-session workshop: grip, sharpening and the core cuts every home cook needs.
learn: Hold and control a chef's knife safely; Sharpen on a whetstone and hone; Dice onions, mince garlic and chiffonade herbs
bring: Your own knife if you want it sharpened (optional)
